newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union-Auckland tame ACT in Super 12 clash.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Auckland tame ACT in Super 12 clash.

text.p: The ACT Brumbies were tamed by a superior Auckland Blues 41-29 in their top-of-the-table Super 12 rugby clash at Auckland's Pukekohe Stadium on Saturday.
The Blues, defending champions, served notice that they were back on form after snatching a fortunate victory against Canterbury a week ago.
ACT's saving grace was a three-try burst in the final six minutes when Auckland were reduced to 14 men after replacement Dylan Mika was sinbinned for a head-high tackle on one of the Brumbies.
